result.title: RelPRM: Grounding Visual Process Reward Models in Relational Evidence
result.summary: Visual process reward models (PRMs) can detect calculation errors yet assign high scores to steps that misread visual relations. Supervision based on subsequent answer success does not directly establish whether a step's relational claim holds. To strengthen visual-relation verification, we first build an automated pipeline that programmatically verifies each claim and identifies the required objects, relations, and image regions. It produces RelProcessTrain and RelProcessBench (RPB), which tests whether scores respond appropriately to relational evidence through controlled image edits and step rephrasings. Building on this pipeline, we further introduce RelPRM, a visual-relation-oriented method for process reward modeling with two training mechanisms. Relation-evidence self-distillation constructs views preserving necessary objects, relations, and dependencies, reducing the burden of finding decisive evidence in complex scenes and transferring reliable evidence-assisted judgments to full images. Relation-evidence-driven consistency training encourages appropriate score changes when relation edits reverse a step's truth, stability under irrelevant edits, and similar score changes across paraphrases. At inference, RelPRM directly scores the current step using only the original image and reasoning context. RelPRM achieves 66.2% on VisualProcessBench (VPB) and 68.4% on RPB, gains of 4.2 and 9.9 percentage points over VisualPRM-8B. These results show that training for visual relations improves both relational verification and step assessment across broader multimodal reasoning tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文关注视觉过程奖励模型（PRM）会给出高分的步骤实则误读视觉关系这一问题，构建可程序化核验关系声明并定位所需对象、关系与图像区域的自动流水线，产出 RelProcessTrain 与 RelProcessBench，并提出 RelPRM 的关系证据自蒸馏与证据驱动一致性训练，推理时仅用原图与推理上下文打分。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于步骤级监督与失败诊断，直接触及「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」及视觉旁路问题；其受控图像编辑与步骤改写测试可供核查 latent 相似度中内容与位置因素的因果作用，值得近期阅读。
